## **1 Tech Tip**


### Drag any image or paste any text into Vimcal


You can now drag any image or paste any text directly into Vimcal and it will figure out what you're trying to do.


This means you can:


-


Drop in the .ics file that got downloaded when you just wanted to “Add to Calendar”


-


Drag in a screenshot of your flight details or a picture of an event flyer


-


Paste in the time and location details from a text or call


-


Drag in a screenshot of times someone suggested to instantly overlay them on your calendar and see what actually works


I demo all 4 of these in this **[<2 min video](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/jaywuzer_can-your-ai-calendar-do-this-you-can-activity-7497671816488833024-l3gK?utm_source=ccingmyea.vimcal.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=thursday-things-aug-27th-2026)** !
